meta.review_notes: Re-analyzed with strict legal-safe rules. Camera_microphone marked unknown because the unified Google privacy policy does not explicitly address camera access for YouTube Music. Contacts_phonebook upgraded to safe because the policy does not clearly attribute contact access to YouTube Music specifically. Removed red_voice_storage flag due to lack of explicit YouTube Music-specific evidence. Fixed policy quotes to use verbatim text. All claims now supported by verbatim policy excerpts.

app.name: YouTube Music
app.description: Stream music, watch videos, and discover new artists.

verdict.one_liner: YouTube Music may use your activity across Google services to show personalized ads, with tools to manage your data.
verdict.summary: YouTube Music states it may show personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services. Google states it does not share information that personally identifies you with advertisers. You can manage ad settings, export your data, and delete your account.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Google's cross-service tracking means your listening activity may be used for ads across its network, but the controls to limit this are real and accessible.

red.title: Your YouTube Music activity may be used for ads across Google
red.plain_english: Google states it may show personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services. This may include activity from YouTube Music.

red.title: Partners collect data via cookies
red.plain_english: Google states it allows specific partners to collect information from your browser or device for advertising and measurement purposes using their own cookies or similar technologies.

red.title: Device identifiers used for ad targeting
red.plain_english: Google states it collects unique identifiers, device type, operating system, carrier, and app version, which are used to provide personalized advertising across Google services.

green.title: Strong data deletion tools
green.plain_english: Google states you can export a copy of your data and delete specific products or your entire Google Account.

green.title: Family Link protections available
green.plain_english: Google mentions Google Accounts Managed with Family Link for children under 13, and provides a Family Link privacy guide.

green.title: Ad personalization can be turned off
green.plain_english: Google states you can control what information is used to show you ads by visiting your ad settings in My Ad Center.

green.title: No ads based on sensitive topics
green.plain_english: Google states it does not show personalized ads based on sensitive categories like race, religion, sexual orientation, or health.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The unified Google privacy policy does not clearly state whether or how YouTube Music accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The policy mentions 'Voice and audio information' as collected activity data, but does not explicitly attribute microphone access to YouTube Music specifically. It does not mention camera access at all for YouTube Music. Because the policy is silent, this category is marked unknown.
concerns: Privacy policy is silent on camera and microphone access for YouTube Music

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Google states it collects location information, including IP address and nearby device signals, which may be used for recommendations and ads.
categories.detail: Location is collected via GPS, IP, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. The policy states: 'We collect location information when you use our services, which helps us offer features like driving directions, search results for things near you, and ads based on your location.' Location can be disabled in device settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect location information when you use our services, which helps us offer features like driving directions, search results for things near you, and ads based on your location.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: YouTube Music does not need your phone contacts to work. The privacy policy does not clearly state that YouTube Music accesses your address book.
categories.detail: YouTube Music's core function is music streaming, which does not require contact or phonebook access. The unified Google privacy policy mentions contacts in the general context of sharing content, but does not clearly attribute contact access to YouTube Music specifically.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload your own music library to YouTube Music. The policy states it collects content you create or upload.
categories.detail: File upload is an optional feature for personal music library. The policy states: 'We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services.' Not required for streaming.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services.
concerns: Uploaded music files are stored on Google servers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Google states it allows specific partners to collect information from your browser or device for advertising and measurement purposes using their own cookies or similar technologies.
categories.detail: Google states it shares information with affiliates, domain administrators, and for legal reasons. It explicitly states: 'We also allow specific partners to collect information from your browser or device for advertising and measurement purposes using their own cookies or similar technologies.' Google states it does not share information that personally identifies you with advertisers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also allow specific partners to collect information from your browser or device for advertising and measurement purposes using their own cookies or similar technologies.
concerns: Partners collect data independently via cookies

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need a Google Account, and Google states it links your activity across services to personalize ads and recommendations.
categories.detail: A Google Account is required for full functionality. The policy states: 'When you're signed in, we also collect information that we store with your Google Account, which we treat as personal information.' Activity across services is linked for personalization and ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you're signed in, we also collect information that we store with your Google Account, which we treat as personal information.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Google states it may show personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.
categories.detail: Activity data is used for personalized ads across Google services and partner sites. The policy states: 'Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.' Users can manage ad settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: YouTube Music is not designed for children under 13. Google mentions Family Link and special accounts with stronger protections for kids.
categories.detail: The policy mentions 'Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13 (or applicable age in your country)' and 'Family Link privacy guide for children & teens.' The main app is not directed at children under 13.
categories.policy_excerpt: Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13 (or applicable age in your country)

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Google states it logs your IP address, crash reports, system activity, and request details. This data is used for security, analytics, and ad targeting.
categories.detail: The policy states it collects 'information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.' This is used for ads and analytics.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.
concerns: IP and activity data used for profiling and ads

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Google states it collects your device identifiers, advertising ID, and hardware details to track you across apps and personalize ads.
categories.detail: The policy states: 'The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.' This is used for ads, security, and syncing.
categories.policy_excerpt: The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.
concerns: Advertising ID used for cross-app ad targeting

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: YouTube Music does not collect health or biometric data. The privacy policy does not mention this category.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy for YouTube Music. Any biometric authentication is handled at the operating system level.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment for premium subscriptions is processed through Google Play billing or Google Pay. The policy states it collects shipping and delivery information for purchases.
categories.detail: Payment is optional and processed via Google's payment infrastructure. The policy states: 'When you purchase services or physical goods from us, you may provide us information like your shipping address or delivery instructions.'
categories.policy_excerpt: When you purchase services or physical goods from us, you may provide us information like your shipping address or delivery instructions.
concerns: Payment handled by Google payment services

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Google states you can export a copy of your data and delete specific products or your entire Google Account.
categories.detail: The policy states: 'You can export a copy of content in your Google Account if you want to back it up or use it with a service outside of Google.' It also lists deletion options for specific services or the entire account. Some retention for legal/security purposes may apply.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can export a copy of content in your Google Account if you want to back it up or use it with a service outside of Google.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google states it will not reduce your rights under the Privacy Policy without your explicit consent, and gives notice for significant changes.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states: 'We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review. If changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice.'
categories.policy_excerpt: We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review.
